content: If the certificate parse operation detects violations to basic en- coding rules on the KeyMCertFormatType such as ASN.1 or TLV (Tag-Length-Values) or violations to any specification relevant for the particular KeyMCertFormatType such as key compression, or if basic elements for that KeyMCertFormatType are missing, the certificate status KEYM_E_CERTIFICATE_INVALID_FORMAT shall be set and re- ported to the application if required by configured callback. No further operation like parsing and validating shall be performed on this certificate until the status has been reset.
